verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API with API-key auth, published OpenAPI 3.1.0 specs, a Try-it playground, date-based versioning and a public MCP server. None of it mentions official client SDKs or libraries in any language. A published OpenAPI spec and a raw HTTP API are building blocks a developer could use to generate or write a client, not an official SDK, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
